title: model-specific runtime optimizations: llama/mistral/qwen GQA/MQA kernel & scheduling tweaks
author: Asha Kulkarni
release_notes: Performance: Model-specific kernel and scheduling improvements for Llama/Mistral/Qwen; GQA/MQA quantization-tuning reduces memory and improves throughput for common sequence lengths; KV cache fix for prefix reuse. No API changes.
description:
Summary: This PR applies a set of model-specific runtime optimizations targeting known quirks in Llama, Mistral, and Qwen families. The work includes kernel selection heuristics, scheduling tweaks for continuous batching, KV-cache hotpaths for prefix reuse, and tuning for group-aware quantization (GQA) / mixed quantization (MQA) code paths. Motivation: customers hitting latency spikes and higher unit costs for 1-8 token sequences in dedicated workloads for these models. This PR reduces tail latency and increases throughput while preserving numerical fidelity for quantized runs.

What changed (high level):
- Kernel selector: added model-aware hints (rotary offset handling for Qwen, block pattern detection for Mistral, fused attention fallback for Llama) so runtime picks optimal kernels per layer/seq-length.
- GQA/MQA tuning: expose quantization-group-size hint and adjusted dequantization ordering to improve cache locality and reduce memory copy for 4-bit/8-bit variants.
- KV cache: optimized prefix reuse hotpath; avoid redundant KV rebuilds for common streaming patterns and re-use persisted slices when request offsets are aligned.
- Continuous batching / scheduler: priority reordering for short-seq requests and faster warm-up path for frequently used model variants.
- Telemetry: new perf counters (kernel_choice, gqa_path, kv_reuse_hits) and accompanying dashboard panels (redwood-console perf).

Testing & benchmarks:
- Microbench: benchmark/fast/llama-13b/throughput vs baseline (seq=32): +12% throughput, p95 latency -9%.
- Qwen-7b (seq=16): +18% throughput after rotary-aware kernel selection.
- Mistral-7b (seq=64): memory reduction ~22% in MQA mode, throughput +8%.
- End-to-end: canary rollout on dedicated clusters showed 6-11% cost/unit savings for real customer traces.

Compatibility & rollout:
- Feature-flag gated (runtime.flags.model_specific_kernels) and rollout via canary groups.
- Safe fallback to previous kernel if numerical deviation > 1e-3 detected by regression checks.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added for kernel selector and kv cache hotpath
- [x] Perf harness and benchmark configs included
- [x] Telemetry counters + console dashboard changes documented
- [x] Feature flag + canary rollout plan
- [x] Security review: no new external surfaces

Notes: See linked Linear ENG-1984 for performance goals and ENG-2032 for telemetry requirements. This PR aggregates multiple small fixes; detailed rationale included in commit messages.
